Kiswahili: Kamanda wa Mkoa wa Nairobi aahidi ulinzi salama wa maandamano ya GenZ kwa kuzingatia kanuni za COP na uratibu na vikundi vya kijamii
Dholuo: Jatend Regional Commander Nairobi osesingore ni obiro rito gik ma timore e kind joma kedo e kind oganda mar GenZ ka oketo chike mag COP kod winjruok gi grube mag oganda

English: Register for the farmer training programme before the application deadline.
Kiswahili: Jiandikishe kwa mpango wa mafunzo ya wakulima kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya maombi.
Dholuo: Ndikri e chenro mar puonjo jopur kapok odiechieng' mogik mar oro kwayo ochopo.

English: Farmers urged to form cooperatives to enhance market access for horticultural products.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wahimizwa kuunda vyama vya ushirika ili kuongeza upatikanaji wa soko la bidhaa za bustani.
Dholuo: Jo puothe ne jiwo ni ji duto oti kanyachiel mondo gikony e loso puothe.

English: The free sanitary products programme now covers learners at Junior Secondary School facing financial hardship.
Kiswahili: mpango wa taulo za bure sasa inahusisha wanafunzi katika shule ya upili ya chini wanaokabiliwa na ugumu wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Program mar gik ma itiyogo e rito ler ma onge chudo sani oriwo jopuonjre ma ni e skul mar sekondari ma yudo pek mag pesa.

English: Appointment of County and Constituency Returning Officers for the General Election Scheduled to be held on 9th August, 2022
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa Wasimamizi wa Uchaguzi wa Kaunti na Majimbo kwa ajili ya Uchaguzi Mkuu ulioratibiwa kufanyika tarehe 9 Agosti, 2022.
Dholuo: Oketo jotelo mag yiero mag kaunti kod gwenge mag yiero mabiro timore tarik 9 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022

English: Though rare, earthquakes can occur. Drop, Cover, and Hold during tremors. Avoid buildings with cracks and report structural weaknesses to authorities.
Kiswahili: Ingawa ni nadra, matetemeko ya ardhi yanaweza kutokea. Kuanguka, Kufunika, na Kushikilia wakati wa mitetemeko. Epuka majengo yenye nyufa na uripoti udhaifu wa kimuundo kwa mamlaka.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni yiengni mag piny ok nyal timore ahinya, buog e ute motegno kendo ichop wach ne migao mochungne arita mag yiengni piny

English: Men are encouraged to accompany their partners to antenatal clinics and support them during pregnancy and after childbirth. Male involvement improves outcomes.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wanahimizwa kuandamana na wenzi wao kwenye kliniki za ujauzito na kuwasaidia wakati wa ujauzito na baada ya kujifungua. Ushiriki wa wanaume huboresha matokeo.
Dholuo: Ijiwo chwo mondo odhi gi mondegi e osiptande mag nyuol kendo konyogi e kinde ma gin gi ich koda bang' nyuol. Bedo gi chwo mang'eny konyo ahinya.

English: Promote gender parity 2023.
Kiswahili: Kukuza usawa wa kijinsia 2023.
Dholuo: Konyuru joma chwo gi mon e higa mar 2023.

English: Provide scholarships for sports 2020.
Kiswahili: Toa ufadhili wa masomo kwa ajili ya michezo 2020.
Dholuo: Chiwo pesa mag somo ne tuke 2020.

English: Nutrition Portal invites submissions recognising counties reporting CNAP outcomes under the new monitoring framework.
Kiswahili: Lango la Lishe linaalika mawasilisho yanayotambua kaunti zinazoripoti matokeo ya CNAP chini ya mfumo mpya wa ufuatiliaji.
Dholuo: Nutrition Portal gwelo ji mondo ochiw ripot manyiso kaka counties ma chiwo ripot mar CNAP kaluwore gi chenro manyien mar nono chal mar chiemo.

English: KRA ON THE ROAD Tax man tours Mombasa County, residents urged to file their returns
Kiswahili: KRA ON THE ROAD Mtoza ushuru azuru Kaunti ya Mombasa, wakazi wahimizwa kuwasilisha marejesho yao
Dholuo: KRA e yoo. Jasol osuru otimo limbe e kaunti mar Mombasa, jodak ojiw mondo ochiw duoko mar osuru.

English: Farmers growing coffee are advised to watch out for locusts this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima kahawa washauriwa kuchunga nzige msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur ma pidho kahawa ipuonjogi mondo gibed gi ritruok kuom winyo mabiro e kindeni.

English: Law Society demanded accountability for commanders behind protest suppression tactics, calling for prosecutions including chain-of-command responsibility.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wanasheria kilidai uwajibikaji kwa makamanda waliohusika na mbinu za kukandamiza maandamano, wakitaka mashtaka yafunguliwe ikiwemo jukumu la mnyororo wa amri.
Dholuo: Law Society ne dwaro ni jotend lweny obed gi ratiro mar tieko akwede, kendo ne gidwaro ni otergi e bura moriwo nyaka joma nigi ratiro mar chiko lweny.

English: Empower girls! Provide scholarships to keep girls in school.
Kiswahili: Wawezeshe wasichana! Toa ufadhili wa masomo ili kuwaweka wasichana shuleni.
Dholuo: Miyo nyiri teko! Chiw pesa ma konyo nyiri dhi nyime gi somo.

English: Protect schools! Communities, guard against banditry.
Kiswahili: Linda shule! Jamii, jilinde dhidi ya ujambazi.
Dholuo: Rituru skunde! Oganda, ritreuru kuom jomecho.

English: Stay informed on cybersecurity threats and follow school safety protocols to keep your family safe.
Kiswahili: Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu vitisho vya usalama wa mtandao na ufuate kanuni za usalama shuleni kuweka familia yako salama.
Dholuo: Bed gi ng'eyo matut kuom gik ma nyalo kelo luoro e mbui kendo luwo chike mag skul mondo orit joodu obed gi arita.

English: Teachers recommend combining asking questions in class with regular attendance to address long distances to school.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kuuliza maswali darasani na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia umbali mrefu kwenda shuleni.
Dholuo: Jopuonj chiwo paro ni mondo oriw penjo e klas kod bedo e klas kinde ka kinde mondo ilos weche mabor mag skul.

English: Protect your maize from maize streak virus by practicing timely weeding.
Kiswahili: Linda mahindi yako dhidi ya virusi vya mistari ya mahindi kwa kupalilia kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Rik chago mari kuom midhusi mar ng'ado chago kuom timo puonjruok mar golo yien e kinde mowinjore.

English: Attend your nearest clinic for HIV testing this month.
Kiswahili: Hudhuria kliniki ya karibu kwa upimaji wa VVU mwezi huu.
Dholuo: Dhi e klinik man machiegni kodi mondo itim pim mar HIV dwe mar apar.

English: Protect your bananas from root rot by mulching early.
Kiswahili: Linda ndizi yako dhidi ya kuoza kwa mizizi kwa kufunika udongo mapema.
Dholuo: Rit ng'injo mari mondo kik otur kuom ng'injogi mapiyo.

English: Be cautious! Avoid chemical hazards near schools.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu! Epuka hatari za kemikali karibu na shule.
Dholuo: Bed motang'! Tang' gi gik manyalo hinyo ng'ato ka in machiegni gi skul.

English: Farmers growing cotton are advised to watch out for drought this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima pamba washauriwa kuchunga ukame msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho pamba ipuonjogi mondo gibed gi ritruok kuom oro e kindeni.

English: Media highlighted calls for an independent investigation into a custodial death, with families demanding prosecution and better detention oversight.
Kiswahili: Vyombo vya habari viliangazia wito wa uchunguzi huru kuhusu kifo cha mtu aliyekamatwa, huku familia zikidai mashtaka na usimamizi bora wa kizuizini.
Dholuo: Jofwamb weche ne onyiso ni ne dwarore ni otim nonro ma onge ratiro kuom tho ma ne otimore e jela, kendo joodgi ne dwaro ni otergi e bura kendo mondo omi gibed gi chenro maber mar rito joma otwe.

English: Reduce class sizes 2022.
Kiswahili: Punguza ukubwa wa madarasa 2022.
Dholuo: Duoko kwan mar jopuonjre chien e higa mar 2022.

English: Understanding public participation in law-making makes it easier to report land grabbing when you see it.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa ushiriki wa umma katika utungaji sheria hurahisisha kuripoti unyakuzi wa ardhi unapoiona.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo kaka oganda ng'ado bura e loso chike miyo bedo mayot mondo ior ripot mar ketho piny ka ineno.

English: Parents should watch for anaemia in children and seek maternal health checkups promptly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuchunga upungufu wa damu kwa watoto na kutafuta uchunguzi wa afya ya uzazi haraka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego orit ka be nyithindo nigi ng'ol mar remo kendo onego gidhi otim nonro mar ngima mar min ma nigi nyithindo mapiyo.

English: Let's talk mental health! If they stopped talking, please check on them.
Kiswahili: Tuzungumzie afya ya akili! Ikiwa waliacha kuzungumza, tafadhali waangalie.
Dholuo: We wawuo ane kuom tuoche mag paro! Kapo ni ne giweyo wuoyo, ng'i ane chal margi.

English: Stay alert, share your info with imposters. Report and block any suspicious accounts.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho, shiriki taarifa zako na wadanganyifu. Ripoti na uzuie akaunti zozote zinazotiliwa shaka.
Dholuo: Bed motang', nyisi weche mari ne joma wuondore, kendo igeng' akaunt moramora ma chiji.

English: Therefore, this move is part of a citywide cleaning exercise which has, so far, included orders requiring hawkers to vacate some of the CBD streets and business owners in the CBD to keep their premises clean and avoid loud systems disrupting the public, among others.
Kiswahili: Kwa hivyo, hatua hii ni sehemu ya zoezi la usafi wa jiji lote ambalo, hadi sasa, limejumuisha maagizo yanayowataka wachuuzi kuondoka katika baadhi ya mitaa ya CBD na wamiliki wa biashara katika CBD ili kuweka majengo yao safi na kuepuka mifumo ya kelele kuwasumbua umma, miongoni mwa mengine.
Dholuo: Kuom mano, chenrono en achiel kuom chenro mar pwodho boma duto, ma nyaka sani oriwo chike ma dwaro ni joma uso e akek yore kod jo-ohala e chuny boma oket kuondegi mag tich obed maler kendo gitang' gi thum mamalo makiko winjruok ekind oganda, e kind mamoko.

English: Protect your cassava from drought by using certified seeds.
Kiswahili: Linda muhogo yako dhidi ya ukame kwa kutumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa.
Dholuo: Rit mzabibu mari mondo kik obed gi oro kuom tiyo kod kodhi ma nigi oboke mar ng'ado bura.

English: KRA reminds taxpayers that agents are not allowed to collect cash payments in person. Use official PayBill numbers and receipts
Kiswahili: KRA inawakumbusha walipa kodi kwamba mawakala hawaruhusiwi kukusanya malipo ya pesa taslimu ana kwa ana. Tumia nambari rasmi za PayBill na risiti
Dholuo: KRA parone josol osuru ni ok oyienegi jotelo kawo pesa e wang' ji.

English: Farmers growing millet are advised to watch out for fungal blight this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima wimbi washauriwa kuchunga ugonjwa wa fangasi msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho ngano ipuonjogi mondo gibed gi ritruok kuom tuoche mag fungi e kindeni.

English: Children aged 1 to 5 should be dewormed every six months to prevent worm infections that can lead to malnutrition and stunted growth.
Kiswahili: Watoto wenye umri wa miaka 1 hadi 5 wanapaswa kusafishwa minyoo kila baada ya miezi sita ili kuzuia maambukizi ya minyoo ambayo yanaweza kusababisha utapiamlo na ukuaji wa kudumaa.
Dholuo: Nyithindo ma hikgi nie kind 1 gi 5 onego ogol kudni e dendgi bang' dweche auchiel ka dweche auchiel, mondo ogeng' tuwo mar kute manyalo kelo kech koda dongo e okang' mamalo.

English: Parents should watch for malnutrition in children and seek family planning services promptly.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kuchunga utapiamlo kwa watoto na kutafuta huduma za uzazi wa mpango haraka.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego orit kaka nyithindo ok yudo chiemo ma ok oromogi kendo onego giyud kony mar rito joot mapiyo.

English: Official roll-out of grant scheme to support vegetable gardens and school nutrition across Nairobi's public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi rasmi wa mpango wa ruzuku ili kusaidia bustani za mboga na lishe shuleni katika shule za msingi za umma jijini Nairobi.
Dholuo: Loso chenro mar chiwo kony mar konyo puothe mag alot kod chiemo e skunde e skunde duto mag Nairobi.

English: Train police in non-discriminatory policing.
Kiswahili: Wafunze polisi katika sera zisizo na ubaguzi.
Dholuo: Tieg polise e yor rito ji e yo maonge nyagruok

English: Any lack of learning materials affecting learners at Junior Secondary School should be raised during infrastructure development plans discussions.
Kiswahili: ukosefu wa vifaa vya kujifunzia yoyote inayoathiri wanafunzi katika shule ya upili ya chini inapaswa kuibuliwa wakati wa majadiliano ya mipango ya uendelezaji wa miundombinu.
Dholuo: Gimoro amora ma onge gi gik mitiyogo e somo ma mulo jopuonjre e Skul mar Sekondari ma piny, onego oketgi e paro e kinde ma itimoe mbaka mag chenro mag dongruok mar gedo mag piny.

English: To reduce corruption, the county is expanding access to disability registration services this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza ufisadi, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa huduma za usajili wa ulemavu mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' tim mag ketho chik, kauntino medo yudo thuolo mar ndiko nying' jogo ma nigi nyawo mag del e higa ni.

English: Launch of Jifunze Lishe SMS service sending weekly nutrition and wellness tips to 2M subscribers.
Kiswahili: Uzinduzi wa huduma ya Jifunze Lishe ya kutuma vidokezo vya lishe na ustawi wa kila wiki kwa wanachama milioni 2.
Dholuo: Chakruok mar chenro mar Jifunze Lishe SMS mar oro paro mag chiemo kod ngima maber juma ka juma ne ji 2M.

English: Learners sitting for Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) and Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) will now be required to shade their answers using Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaofanya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KPSEA) na Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Wadogo ya Kenya (KJSEA) sasa watahitajika kuficha majibu yao kwa kutumia karatasi za Utambuzi wa Alama za Optical (OMR).
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mobiro e penj mar Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA) kod Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA) koro biro dwaro ni gipiem dwoko margi ka gitiyo gi Optical Mark Recognition (OMR) sheets

English: Understanding voter rights and responsibilities makes it easier to report nepotism in hiring when you see it.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa haki na wajibu wa mpiga kura hurahisisha kuripoti upendeleo katika uajiri unapoiona.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo ratiro kod ting' mag jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu miyo bedo mayot mondo igol ripot mar ng'anjo e ng'ado tich ka inene.

English: Keep your poultry healthy by monitoring for signs of Newcastle disease.
Kiswahili: Weka kuku wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za ugonjwa wa mdondo.
Dholuo: Ket winy mari obed mangima kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuo mar Newcastle.

English: Communities facing building collapse risk should follow boat and lake safety rules issued by county disaster teams.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinazokabiliwa na hatari ya kuporomoka kwa jengo zinapaswa kufuata kanuni za usalama wa mashua na ziwa zilizotolewa na timu za maafa za kaunti.
Dholuo: Oganda maromo gi luoro mar ketruok mar udi onego oluw chike mag arita mag yie kod nam ma ogol gi jotend masira mag kaunti.

English: To fight electoral malpractice, the county is promoting local development planning sessions alongside easier access to voter registration updates.
Kiswahili: Ili kupambana na udanganyifu wa uchaguzi, kaunti inahamasisha vikao vya upangaji wa maendeleo ya eneo pamoja na upatikanaji rahisi wa masasisho ya usajili wa wapiga kura.
Dholuo: Mondo oked gi tim marach mag yiero, kauntino loso chenro mag dongruok mag alwora kaachiel gi yudo mayot mar ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu.

English: Protect your millet from flooding by rotating crops.
Kiswahili: Linda wimbi yako dhidi ya mafuriko kwa kubadilisha mazao.
Dholuo: Rit mzabibu mari mondo kik opong' gi pi kuom loko cham.

English: Agroforestry systems provide shade and improve microclimates for livestock, enhancing welfare and productivity.
Kiswahili: Mifumo ya kilimo cha misitu hutoa kivuli na kuboresha hali ya hewa ndogo kwa mifugo, na hivyo kuongeza ustawi na tija.
Dholuo: Chenro mag pur miyo jamni bedo gi piyo kendo gimedo bedo gi ngima maber.

English: Kenya Red Cross provided data on protest-related injuries and EMS response, urging improved pre-positioning of medical resources.
Kiswahili: Msalaba Mwekundu wa Kenya ulitoa data kuhusu majeraha yanayohusiana na maandamano na mwitikio wa EMS, ukihimiza uboreshaji wa upangaji wa awali wa rasilimali za matibabu.
Dholuo: Kenya Red Cross ne ochiwo weche e wi hinyruok ma ne otimore nikech akwede kod kaka ne itimo ne thieth mar thieth, kendo ne okwayo ni mondo thieth obed maber.

English: Keep your donkeys healthy by monitoring for signs of mastitis.
Kiswahili: Weka punda wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za maambukizi ya kiwele.
Dholuo: Ket punda mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuo mar lak.

English: County launches mass supplementation reaching over 12,000 children aged 6–59 months with Vitamin A and deworming to enhance immunity and nutrition.
Kiswahili: Kaunti yazindua virutubisho vingi vinavyowafikia zaidi ya watoto 12,000 wenye umri wa miezi 6-59 kwa kutumia Vitamini A na dawa za minyoo ili kuongeza kinga na lishe.
Dholuo: Kaunti ochako chiwo chiemo ne nyithindo mokalo 12,000 ma hikgi nie kind dweche 6 gi 59 gi Vitamin A kod deworming mondo omed geng'o tuoche kendo omedgi chiemo.

English: Building peer study groups early helps learners succeed under the CBC curriculum.
Kiswahili: Kujenga vikundi vya wenzao vya kusoma mapema husaidia wanafunzi kufaulu chini ya mtaala wa CBC.
Dholuo: Kugero grup mag somo mag jowetegi mapiyo konyo jopuonjre mondo gibed gi loch e bwo chenro mar somo mar CBC.

English: Join public participation forums this month to learn how to access disability registration services and report nepotism in hiring.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma mwezi huu kujifunza jinsi ya kupata huduma za usajili wa ulemavu na kuripoti upendeleo katika uajiri.
Dholuo: Inyalo donjo e forum mag ji duto e dwe ni mondo ing'e kaka inyalo yudo kony mar ndiko nying' jogo ma nigi nyawo mag del kendo ripot mar ng'anjo e weche mag ng'ado tich.

English: The National Disaster Operations Centre has issued an update on disease outbreak alerts.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Uendeshaji wa Maafa kimetoa taarifa kuhusu tahadhari za milipuko ya magonjwa.
Dholuo: Ofis mar piny mangima mar rito masira osegolo wach manyien kuom gik ma nyalo kelo tuoche.

English: Be inspired by the story of Kitale Growers Group, a successful example of secured financing in Taita Taveta.
Kiswahili: Pata msukumo kutoka kwa hadithi ya Kitale Growers Group, mfano mzuri wa ufadhili uliohakikishwa huko Taita Taveta.
Dholuo: Ne ane ranyisi mar Riwruok mar Joluo ma ne dhiga e pinje mamoko, ma en ranyisi maber mar joma ne yudo pesa e piny Taita Taveta.

English: The county government invites residents to citizen feedback sessions scheduled for this month.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya kaunti inawaalika wakazi kwenye vikao vya maoni ya wananchi iliyopangwa mwezi huu.
Dholuo: Sirkal mar kaunti rwako jodak mondo obi e chokruoge mag chiwo paro mag jodak ma oket e dwe ni.

English: NPS refuted a false terror alert online and urged verification through official channels.
Kiswahili: NPS ilikanusha tahadhari ya uwongo ya ugaidi mtandaoni na kuhimiza uthibitishaji kupitia njia rasmi.
Dholuo: NPS ne okwedo siem ma miriambo mar luoro e intanet kendo ne okwayo mondo okonygi ng'eyo wachno kokalo kuom yore mag sirkal.

English: The school feeding programme now covers learners at boarding primary school facing financial hardship.
Kiswahili: mpango wa chakula shuleni sasa inahusisha wanafunzi katika shule ya msingi ya bweni wanaokabiliwa na ugumu wa kifedha.
Dholuo: Program mar chiwo chiemo e skul sani oriwo jopuonjre ma ni e skul ma piny ma nigi pek mag pesa.

English: An MoU was signed to integrate gender equality into national PCVE structures and empower women in terrorism-prevention roles.
Kiswahili: MoU ilisainiwa ili kuunganisha usawa wa kijinsia katika miundo ya kitaifa ya PCVE na kuwawezesha wanawake katika majukumu ya kuzuia ugaidi.
Dholuo: Ne oket sei e winjruok mar timo winjruok e kind chwo gi mon e bwo chenro mag piny mangima mar PCVE kendo miyo mon teko mar loyo timbe mahundu.

English: Farmers growing cassava are advised to watch out for coffee berry disease this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima muhogo washauriwa kuchunga ugonjwa wa chungu wa kahawa msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho mzabibu ipuonjogi mondo gibed gi ritruok kuom tuo mar berry mag kahawa e kindeni.

English: Prevent substance abuse in schools 2025.
Kiswahili: Kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya dawa za kulevya shuleni 2025.
Dholuo: Geng'o tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero e skunde e higa mar 2025.

English: Learn how farmers can earn carbon credits by adopting practices on the dairy farm that remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi wakulima wanavyoweza kupata mikopo ya kaboni kwa kutumia mbinu za kilimo cha maziwa zinazoondoa kaboni dioksidi kutoka angani.
Dholuo: Ne ane kaka jopur nyalo tiyo gi yore mag pidho chak ma golo carbon dioxide e kor lwasi mondo gibed gi kido mar timo gik ma kelo muya.

English: Stay informed on security threats and follow workplace safety standards to keep your family safe.
Kiswahili: Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu vitisho vya usalama na ufuate viwango vya usalama mahali pa kazi kuweka familia yako salama.
Dholuo: Bed gi ng'eyo kuom gik ma nyalo ketho arita kendo luwo chike mag arita e kar tich mondo orit joodu obed gi arita.

English: Appointment of RO and DRO for the purpose of the by-election for Batalu CAW
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa RO na DRO kwa madhumuni ya uchaguzi mdogo wa Batalu CAW
Dholuo: Oketo RO kod DRO mondo otim yiero matin mar Batalu CAW

English: Health workers recommend learning about elderly care alongside practicing using treated mosquito nets at home.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya wanapendekeza kujifunza kuhusu utunzaji wa wazee pamoja na kufanya kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa nyumbani.
Dholuo: Jotich mag thieth nyiso ni onego opuonjre kaka onego orit jogo mahikgi oniang' kaachiel gi puonjruok mar tiyo kod gik ma itiyogo e geng'o suna e ot.

English: Men's mental health awareness is critically important because they face unique challenges and pressures from society. Research shows that men are less likely to ask for help with mental health issues than women. This is often because society expects men not to show vulnerability or emotions. This can lead to serious problems, including a higher rate of suicide among men, who are almost four times more likely to die by suicide than women
Kiswahili: Uelewa wa afya ya akili ya wanaume ni muhimu sana kwa sababu wanakabiliwa na changamoto na shinikizo la kipekee kutoka kwa jamii. Utafiti unaonyesha kuwa wanaume wana uwezekano mdogo wa kuomba msaada kuhusu masuala ya afya ya akili kuliko wanawake. Hii mara nyingi ni kwa sababu jamii inatarajia wanaume kutoonyesha udhaifu au hisia. Hii inaweza kusababisha matatizo makubwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na kiwango cha juu cha kujiua miongoni mwa wanaume, ambao wana uwezekano wa karibu mara nne zaidi wa kufa kwa kujiua kuliko wanawake.
Dholuo: Bedo gi chuny mar ng'eyo tuoche mag paro kuom chwo en gima dwarore ahinya nikech chwo romo gi pek moko makende kod tembe mawuok kuom oganda. Nonro nyiso ni joma chwo ok ohero kwayo kony kuom weche mag tuoche mag paro maloyo joma mon. Kinde mang'eny, mano en nikech oganda ji dwaro ni chwo kik nyis ni gin joma yomyom kata maok nyal kony. Mano nyalo kelo chandruoge madongo, moriwo nyaka kwan momedore mar chwo matemo negore, kwanno chiegni nyading'wen maloyo mar mon matemo negore

English: Citizens who understand public participation in law-making are better placed to report abuse of office when it occurs.

English: Protect your sorghum from root rot by mulching early.
Kiswahili: Linda mtama yako dhidi ya kuoza kwa mizizi kwa kufunika udongo mapema.
Dholuo: Riek cham mari mondo kik otur kuom ng'ado lum mapiyo.

English: A terrorism threat report outlines activity by al Shabaab and IS and stresses public vigilance.

English: Ksh 22,244 capitation per day-scholar released – principals must NOT ask for extra money!

English: Public warning: There are no County Government jobs offered via agents in town. Anyone asking for a facilitation fee is running a scam.

English: Parents: Check if your child is registered to vote – guide on education.go.ke!

English: One hundred forty eight park officers trained to strengthen early detection of terror related threats around major tourism areas.

English: Learn about extension services available in your area from KALRO. Know how to access advice, training, and support.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kuhusu huduma za ugani zinazopatikana katika eneo lako kutoka KALRO. Jua jinsi ya kupata ushauri, mafunzo, na usaidizi.

English: Malaria vaccine advisory: More children in malaria endemic counties to be vaccinated. WHO has given an approval for expanded use of the vaccine. 275,000 children partially jabbed, 45,000 are fully vaccinated. Data shows the number of malaria cases has gone down
Kiswahili: Ushauri wa chanjo ya malaria: Watoto zaidi katika kaunti zilizoathiriwa na malaria watachanjwa. WHO imetoa idhini ya matumizi ya chanjo hiyo kwa upana zaidi. Watoto 275,000 wachapwa sehemu, 45,000 wamechanjwa kikamilifu. Data inaonyesha idadi ya visa vya malaria imepungua
Dholuo: Giko mar chanjo mar malaria: Nyithindo mang'eny e gwenge ma malaria opong'o ibiro chanjo. WHO osechiwo thuolo mar tiyo gi chanjo mar Corona e okang' momedore. Nyithindo 275,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona e okang' matin, kendo nyithindo 45,000 osemi chanjo mar Corona chuth. Nonro nyiso ni kwan mar joma nigi malaria osedok chien

English: The Public Service Commission (PSC) has advertised 86 job opportunities for Kenyan professionals under the State Department for Foreign and Diaspora Affairs.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Utumishi wa Umma (PSC) imetangaza nafasi 86 za kazi kwa wataalamu wa Kenya chini ya Idara ya Mambo ya Nje na Diaspora.
Dholuo: Kamisen mar jotije mar PSC oselando thuolo mag tije piero aboro gi auchiel ne joma olony e Kenya e bwo migawo mar weche ma oko.

English: Students who scored C- and below in their 2023 Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE) exam can pursue diploma and certificate courses in the medical field. The courses are offered at Kenya Me...
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi waliopata alama ya C- na chini katika mtihani wao wa Cheti cha Elimu ya Sekondari cha Kenya (KCSE) cha 2023 wanaweza kufuata kozi za diploma na cheti katika uwanja wa matibabu. Kozi hizo zinatolewa katika Kenya Me...

English: WHO does not recommend any restriction on travel and trade to Kenya based on the information available on the current outbreak.
Kiswahili: WHO haipendekezi vikwazo vyovyote vya usafiri na biashara hadi Kenya kulingana na taarifa zilizopo kuhusu mlipuko wa sasa.
Dholuo: WHO ok ogolo chik moro amora kuom wuotho ​​kod ohala e piny Kenya kaluwore gi weche ma nitie e wi tuo mar korona.

English: Lead the way! Participate in school leadership elections.
Kiswahili: Ongoza njia! Shiriki katika uchaguzi wa uongozi wa shule.
Dholuo: Nyisa yo! Dhi e chokruoge mag yiero jotelo mag skunde.

English: Stay informed on security threats and follow fire safety precautions to keep your family safe.
Kiswahili: Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu vitisho vya usalama na ufuate tahadhari za usalama wa moto kuweka familia yako salama.
Dholuo: Bed gi ng'eyo matut kuom gik ma nyalo kelo luoro kendo luwo okenge mag arita mar mach mondo orit joodu maber.

English: Promote awareness on winning discrimination cases.
Kiswahili: Kukuza uelewa kuhusu kushinda kesi za ubaguzi.
Dholuo: Jiw ji mondo ong'e kaka inyalo loyo kes mag buono ji.

English: Free national digital library launched – 100,000 books, no login required!
Kiswahili: Maktaba ya kitaifa ya kidijitali ya bure yazinduliwa – Vitabu 100,000, hakuna kuingia kunakohitajika!
Dholuo: Laibrari mar piny mangima mar digital ma onge chudo, ne ogolo buge 100,000, maonge chuno mar donjo!

English: EACC reaffirms its commitment to combating fraud and safeguarding integrity within the public service sector, a statement from the commission said.
Kiswahili: EACC inathibitisha tena kujitolea kwake kupambana na ulaghai na kulinda uadilifu ndani ya sekta ya utumishi wa umma, taarifa kutoka kwa tume hiyo ilisema.

English: "Public notice: DCI has shut down a fraudulent real estate company operating under multiple names in Kiambu. Always perform a search at the Lands Ministry."

English: Chairman's Remarks during the Launch of the 2022 Post Election Evaluation Report held at the Safari Park Hotel on Monday 16th January 2023
Kiswahili: Hotuba ya Mwenyekiti wakati wa Uzinduzi wa Ripoti ya Tathmini ya Baada ya Uchaguzi wa 2022 uliofanyika katika Hoteli ya Safari Park Jumatatu tarehe 16 Januari 2023.

English: Parents should watch for malnutrition in children and seek dental checkups promptly.

English: Kenya enhances disease surveillance systems for early detection of livestock diseases.
Kiswahili: Kenya inaboresha mifumo ya ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa kwa ajili ya kugundua mapema magonjwa ya mifugo.

English: Stay informed on flooding risk and follow crowd safety measures to keep your family safe.
Kiswahili: Endelea kufahamishwa kuhusu hatari ya mafuriko na ufuate hatua za usalama wa umati kuweka familia yako salama.
Dholuo: Bed gi ng'eyo kuom luoro mar pi ma pong'o piny kendo luwo okenge mag arita mag oganda mondo orit joodu maber.

English: SHA favorable to marginalized communities, MP Geoffrey Ruku urges Mbeere North residents to register with Social Health Authority (SHA).
Kiswahili: Mbunge Geoffrey Ruku, ambaye ni mshirika wa SHA anayependelea jamii zilizotengwa, anawasihi wakazi wa Mbeere Kaskazini kujiandikisha na Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA).

English: Learn to recognize trauma symptoms and provide psychological first aid to disaster survivors.
Kiswahili: Jifunze kutambua dalili za kiwewe na kutoa huduma ya kwanza ya kisaikolojia kwa manusura wa majanga.
Dholuo: Puonjri fwenyo chal mar tuwo moro ma ne oyudo ng'ato ka en e masira kendo ikony joma oyudo masira.

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine public participation forums participation with awareness of accessing government services online.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma na uelewa wa kupata huduma za serikali mtandaoni.

English: Protect your sugarcane from fall armyworm by rotating crops.
Kiswahili: Linda miwa yako dhidi ya funza jeshi kwa kubadilisha mazao.

English: Skin-to-skin care helps stabilize small or preterm babies and promotes weight gain and bonding.

English: Join civil society initiatives to advocate for transparency and governance reforms.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na mipango ya asasi za kiraia ili kutetea uwazi na mageuzi ya utawala.

English: The Commission urges voters, candidates and agents to maintain order at all polling stations, avoid wearing or carrying campaign materials and to avoid campaigning while on the queue #October14thBy-elections.

English: A topic which has never been a subject for public participation in Parliament even after the establishment of the Public Debt and Privatization Committee in the National Assembly (13 th Parliament).

English: Protect your bananas from locusts by rotating crops.
Kiswahili: Linda ndizi yako dhidi ya nzige kwa kubadilisha mazao.
Dholuo: Rit ng'injo mari mondo kik oyud winyo kuom loko cham ma ipidho.

English: Citizens are urged to provide information on to improve service provision.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kutoa taarifa kuhusu kuboresha utoaji wa huduma.

English: Keep your poultry healthy by monitoring for signs of lumpy skin disease.
Kiswahili: Weka kuku wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za ugonjwa wa ngozi ya uvimbe.
Dholuo: Ket winy mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuoche mag dend lumpy.

English: Create a #TIMS account http://ntsa.go.ke, click on TIMS register account then apply for smart DL.

English: Breast milk contains nutrients vital for a baby's brain development.
Kiswahili: Maziwa ya mama yana virutubisho muhimu kwa ukuaji wa ubongo wa mtoto.
Dholuo: Kodhi mar miyo nigi gik makonyo nyathi mondo obwongone obed motegno.

English: Devastating flooding in South Sudan is affecting around 1.4 million people, with more than 379,000 displaced, according to a United Nations update that warned about an upsurge in malaria.
Kiswahili: Mafuriko makubwa nchini Sudan Kusini yanaathiri takriban watu milioni 1.4, huku zaidi ya watu 379,000 wakimbizi, kulingana na taarifa mpya ya Umoja wa Mataifa iliyoonya kuhusu ongezeko la malaria.
Dholuo: Ataro mar pi e piny South Sudan, osemiyo ji madirom milion 1.4 oyudo masira, kendo ji mokalo 379,000 oseweyo miechgi, kaluwore gi nonro manyien mar Riwruok mar Pinje ma ne ochiwo siem ni malaria biro medore.

English: To fight corruption, the county is promoting county budget consultations alongside easier access to voter registration updates.
Kiswahili: Ili kupambana na ufisadi, kaunti inahamasisha mashauriano ya bajeti ya kaunti pamoja na upatikanaji rahisi wa masasisho ya usajili wa wapiga kura.

English: Join community schools! Affordable education for low-income families.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na shule za jamii! Elimu ya bei nafuu kwa familia zenye kipato cha chini.
Dholuo: Donj e skunde mag jopiny! Somo ma nengone yot ne joot ma nigi pesa matin.

English: Understanding how county budgets work makes it easier to report misuse of public funds when you see it.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa jinsi bajeti za kaunti zinavyofanya kazi hurahisisha kuripoti matumizi mabaya ya fedha za umma unapoiona.
Dholuo: Ka ing'eyo kaka bajet mag kaunti tiyo, mano miyo bedo mayot mondo ior ripot mar tiyo marach gi pesa mag piny ka inene.

English: Reading to children daily boosts language development, imagination, and bonding.
Kiswahili: Kusomea watoto kila siku huongeza ukuaji wa lugha, mawazo, na uhusiano.
Dholuo: Somo ne nyithindo pile miyo dhok ma giwacho dongo, pachgi tiyo maber, kendo miyo gibedo gi winjruok maber gi jomoko.

English: Protests caused disruptions; stay alert and follow safety guidance.
Kiswahili: Maandamano yalisababisha usumbufu; kaa macho na fuata mwongozo wa usalama.
Dholuo: Gik ma ne otimore ne ji ne ok dhi maber; ne dwarore ni ibed motang' kendo iluw weche ma ne okor.

English: Combine boiling drinking water with regular child growth monitoring visits to stay healthy all year round.
Kiswahili: Changanya kuchemsha maji ya kunywa na ziara za mara kwa mara za ufuatiliaji wa ukuaji wa mtoto ili kuwa na afya mwaka mzima.
Dholuo: Kod pi ma ng'ich mar madho kod limo pile ka pile mar luwo dongruok mar nyathi mondo obed gi ngima maber higa duto.

English: Report inadequate sanitation facilities at school to the head teacher immediately.
Kiswahili: Ripoti vyoo visivyotosha shuleni kwa mwalimu mkuu mara moja.
Dholuo: Chiw ripot ne japuonj maduong' mapiyo kuom kuonde ma ok oromo mag ler e skul.

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine anti-corruption awareness campaigns participation with awareness of voter rights and responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika kampeni za uhamasishaji dhidi ya ufisadi na uelewa wa haki na wajibu wa mpiga kura.
Dholuo: Jotelo jiwo jopiny mondo oket kanyakla bedo e kampen mag puonjo ji e wi tim mar ketho chik kod ng'eyo ratiro kod ting' mag jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu.

Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kupitia kazi za nyumbani mara kwa mara na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia hali isiyo salama ya darasa.

Kiswahili: Vituo vya Kupigia Kura kwa Uchaguzi Mdogo Ulioratibiwa kufanyika tarehe 8 Disemba, 2022 Katika Kaunti ya Bungoma, Utawala, Ololmasani, Kyome/Thaana, Gem Kusini na Wadi za Mumias Kaskazini katika Jiji la Nairobi, Narok, Kitui, Kaunti za Siaya na Kakamega Mtawalia.

Kiswahili: Elimu ya uraia sasa 30% ya alama ya mwisho ya Daraja la 9 – pakua madokezo ya bure kutoka KICD TODAY!

English: The Kenya Agricultural Marketing Strategy (AMS) 2023-2032 highlights on leveraging digital technologies to enhance market access for small farmers.
Kiswahili: Mkakati wa Masoko ya Kilimo wa Kenya (AMS) 2023-2032 unaangazia matumizi ya teknolojia za kidijitali ili kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko kwa wakulima wadogo.

English: Teachers recommend combining active class participation with regular attendance to address overcrowded classrooms.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kushiriki kikamilifu darasani na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia madarasa yenye msongamano.

English: The Commission urges Machakos voters to turn out & exercise their democratic right
Kiswahili: Tume yawahimiza wapiga kura wa Machakos kujitokeza na kutumia haki yao ya kidemokrasia
Dholuo: Kamisen'no dwaro ni josiasa ma Machakos owuog oko kendo giti gi ratiro ma gin-go mar timo yiero.

English: Anyone showing signs of anaemia should also be checked for measles at a nearby clinic.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeonyesha dalili za upungufu wa damu pia anapaswa kuchunguzwa kwa surua katika kliniki ya karibu.

English: Stay vigilant! Report banditry threats near schools to police.
Kiswahili: Kuwa macho! Ripoti vitisho vya ujambazi karibu na shule kwa polisi.
Dholuo: Beduru motang'! Lando ne polise ka nitie jokuoge machiegni gi skunde.

English: Combine regular handwashing with soap with regular cancer screening visits to stay healthy all year round.
Kiswahili: Changanya kunawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na ziara za mara kwa mara za uchunguzi wa saratani ili kuwa na afya mwaka mzima.

English: Healthcare facilities must screen for violence and provide safe and comprehensive responses for survivors.
Kiswahili: Vituo vya huduma ya afya lazima vichunguze vurugu na kutoa majibu salama na ya kina kwa waathirika.

English: EACC supports local offices to prevent misuse of public funds.

English: Teachers recommend combining keeping a study timetable with regular attendance to address delayed textbook delivery.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kuweka ratiba ya masomo na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia ucheleweshaji wa vitabu.
Dholuo: Jopuonj golo paro ni mondo oriw keto chenro mar somo kod bedo e chokruoge pile mondo ilos dero mar chopo buge mag somo.

Kiswahili: Endelea kujifunza! Saidia shule zilizo katika maeneo ya ukame.
Dholuo: Dhi Nyime Puonjori! Konyuru skunde man kuonde ma oro ng'enyie.

Kiswahili: Epuka ajali katika maegesho yenye watu wengi; endelea kuwa macho.
Dholuo: Kik ichop neno masira mar apaya kuonde ma ji ng'enyie; bed motang'.

English: Dress for success! Apply for uniform subsidies for needy students.
Kiswahili: Vaa kwa ajili ya mafanikio! Omba ruzuku ya sare kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji.
Dholuo: Rwakri maber mondo ibed gi ngima maber! Kwa mondo omiyi kony mar pesa ma ok okal tong' ne jopuonjre modhier.

English: "The Ministry of ICT reminds citizens that all eCitizen payments are automated. Do not send money to personal numbers for services."
Kiswahili: "Wizara ya TEHAMA inawakumbusha raia kwamba malipo yote ya kielektroniki ni otomatiki. Usitume pesa kwa nambari za kibinafsi kwa huduma."
Dholuo: "Ministerio mar ICT parone raia ni chudo duto mag eCitizen itimo gi masinde. Kik ior pesa e namba mag ji mondo iyudgo tich".

English: Citizens are encouraged to join town hall meetings organised by the county government.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kujiunga na mikutano ya hadhara zinazoandaliwa na serikali ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Jodak jiwo mondo odonj e chokruoge mag od bura ma sirkal mar kaunti oloso.

English: Avoid rebuilding in landslide-prone areas. Government offers alternative land for affected families.
Kiswahili: Epuka kujenga upya katika maeneo yanayokumbwa na maporomoko ya ardhi. Serikali inatoa ardhi mbadala kwa familia zilizoathiriwa.
Dholuo: Kik uger kuonde ma lowo olwar ahinya, nikech sirkal chiwo lowo ma nyalo konyo joodgi ma masira mar yiengni omako.

English: Commissioner Francis Wanderi urges media, in the spirit of transparency, to send staff in all polling station to report results as declared by Presiding & Returning Officers.
Kiswahili: Kamishna Francis Wanderi anahimiza vyombo vya habari, kwa roho ya uwazi, kutuma wafanyakazi katika vituo vyote vya kupigia kura kuripoti matokeo kama yalivyotangazwa na Wasimamizi na Maafisa wa Kurudi.
Dholuo: kamisona Francis Wanderi jiwo jofwambo e chuny mar ler e tich mondo oor jotich e kombe duto mag yiero mondo ochiw ripode kaka ne oland gi jotelo mochung' ne lendo mag yiero.

English: Educate on bail and bond rights.
Kiswahili: Kuelimisha kuhusu dhamana na haki za dhamana.
Dholuo: Puonjri weche mag twech ne joma osemaki kod sirkal.

English: Families should include children in disaster drills and ensure they know emergency contacts.
Kiswahili: Familia zinapaswa kuwajumuisha watoto katika mazoezi ya majanga na kuhakikisha wanawajua watu wa dharura.
Dholuo: Joot onego oriw nyithindo e tiegruok mag masiche kendo nyaka ging'e joma ginyalo tudorego gi joma nigi chandruok.

English: Hospitals should have trained staff to handle child abuse cases with confidentiality and care.
Kiswahili: Hospitali zinapaswa kuwa na wafanyakazi waliofunzwa kushughulikia kesi za unyanyasaji wa watoto kwa usiri na utunzaji.
Dholuo: Osiptende onego obed gi joma otieg e kaka irito nyithindo e yo mariek kendo maonge luoro.

English: Join civic education drives this month to learn how to access land title services and report delayed government services.
Kiswahili: Jiunge na kampeni za elimu ya uraia mwezi huu kujifunza jinsi ya kupata huduma za hati za ardhi na kuripoti huduma za serikali kuchelewa.
Dholuo: Ibed gi chenro mag somo mar oganda e dwe ni mondo ing'e kaka inyalo yud huduma mag oboke mar piny kendo igoyo ripot mar huduma mag sirkal ma odagi.

English: This talk about digital agriculture and its potential to reduce rural poverty featured Prof. Michael Kremer, 2019 winner of the Nobel Memorial Prize in ...
Kiswahili: Mazungumzo haya kuhusu kilimo cha kidijitali na uwezo wake wa kupunguza umaskini vijijini yalimhusisha Profesa Michael Kremer, mshindi wa Tuzo ya Nobel ya 2019 katika ...
Dholuo: Puonj ma ne ochiw e wi pur mar digital kod kaka onyalo tieko dhier e gwenge mosokore ne ochiw gi Prof. Michael Kremer, ma ne oyudo mich mar Nobel mar 2019 e wi dhier.

English: Public advised not to circulate graphic images after the DusitD2 attack to protect victims' dignity.
Kiswahili: Umma ulishauri kutosambaza picha za picha baada ya shambulio la DusitD2 ili kulinda heshima ya waathiriwa.
Dholuo: Ji ne okwayo mondo kik giland piche jomosenindo bang' monj mar DusitD2 mondo omi girit luor mar joma ne otho.

English: Citizens who understand public participation in law-making are better placed to report delayed government services when it occurs.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanaoelewa ushiriki wa umma katika utungaji sheria wako katika nafasi nzuri zaidi ya kuripoti huduma za serikali kuchelewa inapotokea.
Dholuo: Jodak ma winjo tiend bedo gi ng'eyo mar oganda e loso chike, gin joma nigi thuolo maber mar chiwo ripot mar tich ma sirkal osetimo ka otimore.

English: 3105 - Declaration of Persons Elected in the By-Elections Held on 26th February, 2026
Kiswahili: 3105 - Tamko la Watu Waliochaguliwa Katika Uchaguzi Mdogo Uliofanyika tarehe 26 Februari, 2026
Dholuo: 3105 - Lero mar Joma Oyier e Yiero Matin ma Ne Otim tarik 26 dwe mar ariyo higa mar 2026

English: Pregnant women in their second trimester should receive deworming medication to improve nutrition and reduce complications.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wajawazito katika miezi mitatu yao ya pili ya ujauzito wanapaswa kupokea dawa za minyoo ili kuboresha lishe na kupunguza matatizo.
Dholuo: Mon ma yach e trimester mar ariyo onego oyud yedhe mag geng'o kute mag kute mondo omi gimed chamo chiemo maber kendo geng'o midekre.

English: During displacement crises, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of landslides.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa migogoro ya kuhamishwa, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na maporomoko ya ardhi.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masira mag weyo udigi, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma inyalo tudruokgo mapiyo ka piny otur.

English: Secure exam materials 2021.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya mtihani salama 2021.
Dholuo: Rit maber gik mitiyogo e penj mar 2021.

English: Refugee and displaced populations require protection measures and community involvement to reduce violence risks.
Kiswahili: Wakimbizi na watu waliohamishwa makazi yao wanahitaji hatua za ulinzi na ushirikishwaji wa jamii ili kupunguza hatari za vurugu.
Dholuo: Joma oringo thuchegi onego omi arita kue margi kuonde mag gidake

English: A public forum in Kakamega enabled citizens to report misconduct directly to officials, strengthening community oversight.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la umma huko Kakamega liliwawezesha raia kuripoti utovu wa nidhamu moja kwa moja kwa maafisa, na hivyo kuimarisha usimamizi wa jamii.
Dholuo: Chokruok moro mar ji duto ma ne otim Kakamega ne omiyo raia thuolo mar nyiso jotelo wach timbe maricho ma ne gitimo, kendo mano nomiyo ji omedo bedo gi paro maler

English: During road accident emergencies, always keep emergency contacts on hand in case of drought.
Kiswahili: Wakati wa dharura za ajali za barabarani, weka nambari za dharura karibu endapo kutakuwa na ukame.
Dholuo: E kinde mag masira mag ndara, kinde duto bed gi jogo ma nyalo konyi e lweti ka ng'ato otho.

English: Ensure there are confidential channels for employees to seek mental health support without fear of retaliation or judgment
Kiswahili: Hakikisha kuna njia za siri kwa wafanyakazi kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili bila hofu ya kulipiza kisasi au hukumu.
Dholuo: Mon nyalo romo gi pek moko makende e yudo thieth, moriwo ting' mag rito nyithindo, pek mag yuto, kod luoro mar wichkuot, manyalo ketho pachgi.

English: Combine regular handwashing with soap with regular immunization services visits to stay healthy all year round.
Kiswahili: Changanya kunawa mikono mara kwa mara kwa sabuni na ziara za mara kwa mara za huduma za chanjo ili kuwa na afya mwaka mzima.
Dholuo: Kod lwoko lwedo pile ka pile gi sabun ka idhi limo kar thieth pile ka pile mondo ibed gi ngima maber e higa duto.

English: Document and resist illegal evictions; share lessons learned.
Kiswahili: Andika na pinga kufukuzwa kinyume cha sheria; shiriki masomo uliyojifunza.
Dholuo: Ping wach mar daro ji e utegi e yo ma ok luw chik; puonjgi gik ma isepuonjori.

English: Outbreaks of malaria are prevented through using treated mosquito nets and timely maternal health checkups.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya malaria huzuiwa kupitia kutumia vyandarua vilivyotibiwa na uchunguzi wa afya ya uzazi kwa wakati.
Dholuo: Ogeng'o tuoche mag maleria kokalo kuom tiyo kod gik ma itiyogo e geng'o suna kod timo nonro mag ngima mar mon e kinde mowinjore.

English: WHO does not recommend any restriction on travel and trade to the Republic of Kenya based on the information available on the current outbreak.
Kiswahili: WHO haipendekezi vikwazo vyovyote vya usafiri na biashara kwa Jamhuri ya Kenya kulingana na taarifa zilizopo kuhusu mlipuko wa sasa.
Dholuo: WHO ok ogolo paro ni onego oket chik moro amora kuom wuotho ​​kod ohala e piny Kenya kaluwore gi weche ma nitie ewi tuo mar korona.

English: Wrap babies in warm clothes and avoid exposing them to cold air, especially in early months.
Kiswahili: Wafunge watoto nguo za joto na epuka kuwaweka kwenye hewa baridi, hasa katika miezi ya mwanzo.
Dholuo: Bed gi lewni maliet mondo irwakgi, kendo kik iketgi kama ng'ich ahinya, to moloyo e dweche mokwongo.

English: ARTICLE 19 urges the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission on Sudan and the International Criminal Court to specifically consider how the information war in Sudan exacerbates harm to civilians, obstructs vital documentation of gross human rights and humanitarian law violations, and contributes to the commission of crimes.
Kiswahili: KIFUNGU CHA 19 kinahimiza Ujumbe Huru wa Kimataifa wa Kutafuta Ukweli kuhusu Sudan na Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Jinai kuzingatia mahususi jinsi vita vya habari nchini Sudan vinavyozidisha madhara kwa raia, kuzuia uandishi muhimu wa haki za binadamu na ukiukwaji mkubwa wa sheria za kibinadamu, na kuchangia katika utendaji wa uhalifu.
Dholuo: SULA MAR apar gi ochiko jiwo kamisen mar ratich oganda e piny mangima e piny Sudan kod od bura mar piny mangima mondo onon ahinya kaka lwenje mag weche e piny Sudan medo ketho ngima raia, geng'o weche motudore gi ratiro mag dhano kod ketho chike mag dhano, koda kaka gikonyo e tieko timbe mahundu.

English: Learn ethics! Include anti-corruption in school curricula.
Kiswahili: Jifunze maadili! Jumuisha kupambana na rushwa katika mitaala ya shule.
Dholuo: Puonjri timbe mabeyo! Ket weche mag kedo gi mibadhi obed achiel kuom gik ma ipuonjo e skul.

English: Learn more about safe pregnancy practices by visiting your community health worker.
Kiswahili: Jifunze zaidi kuhusu mazoezi salama ya ujauzito kwa kutembelea mhudumu wa afya wa jamii yako.
Dholuo: Ng'e mathoth kuom yore mabeyo mag bedo gi ich kuom dhi limo jatich mar thieth ma ni e alworau.

English: Improving both women and men's agricultural market access improves dietary diversity, but women's effect is double that of men.
Kiswahili: Kuboresha upatikanaji wa soko la kilimo kwa wanawake na wanaume kunaboresha utofauti wa lishe, lakini athari ya wanawake ni mara mbili ya ile ya wanaume.
Dholuo: Kata obedo ni dongruok ma chwo kod mon timo e tij pur miyo chiemo bedo mopogore opogore, mon yudo nyak mamalo moloyo chwo.

English: Keep your goats healthy by monitoring for signs of foot-and-mouth disease.
Kiswahili: Weka mbuzi wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za ugonjwa wa miguu na midomo.
Dholuo: Ket dier mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuoche mag tielo kod dhok.

English: Free startup toolkits worth Ksh 150,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates!
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya kuanzisha biashara bila malipo vyenye thamani ya Ksh 150,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025!
Dholuo: Gige tich ma onge chudo ma nengogi romo Ksh 150,000 ne jogo duto ma osetieko tiegruok mar TVET e higa mar 2025!

English: IPOA spotlighted a serious misconduct case in Mombasa, calling for transparency and systemic discipline reforms.
Kiswahili: IPOA iliangazia kesi kubwa ya utovu wa nidhamu huko Mombasa, ikitaka uwazi na mageuzi ya nidhamu ya kimfumo.
Dholuo: IPOA ne oketo ranyisi mar ketho chik maduong' e Mombasa, kendo ne okwayo ni otim lokruok e weche ma nyiso ni ji ong'eyo weche duto kendo ni otim lokruok e yo ma tayo chik.

English: Train on online safety 2021.
Kiswahili: Treni kuhusu usalama mtandaoni 2021.
Dholuo: Tieguru ji kaka ginyalo tiyo gi intanet e yo maber.

English: July 7 protests expected; avoid major towns and demonstrations.
Kiswahili: Maandamano ya Julai 7 yanatarajiwa; kuepuka miji mikubwa na maandamano.
Dholuo: Ne igeno ni ibiro tim gik ma ne dhi timore e dwe mar Julai 7, kendo ne ok idhi tim gik ma ne dhi timore e taonde madongo.

English: To reduce unfair resource allocation, the county is expanding access to birth certificate registration this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza ugawaji usio wa haki wa rasilimali, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa usajili wa cheti cha kuzaliwa mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' chiwo mwandu ma ok owinjore, kaunti medo ng'eyo kaka inyalo ndiko nying' oboke mag nyuol e higa ni.

English: Misuse of veterinary drugs creates resistance. Buy from licensed sources and follow prescriptions.
Kiswahili: Matumizi mabaya ya dawa za mifugo husababisha upinzani. Nunua kutoka kwa vyanzo vilivyoidhinishwa na ufuate maagizo ya daktari.
Dholuo: Tiyo marach gi yedhe mamero chando ji miyo ng'ato bedo gi chuny mar kwedo yedhe mamero.

English: Free toolkits worth Ksh 100,000 for all 2025 TVET graduates in technical courses.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya bure vyenye thamani ya Ksh 100,000 kwa wahitimu wote wa TVET wa 2025 katika kozi za ufundi.
Dholuo: Gige tich ma onge chudo ma nengogi romo Ksh 100,000 ne jogo duto ma osetieko tiegruok e yore mag tiegruok gi lony e higni 2025 e yore mag lony.

English: Officials encourage citizens to combine public participation forums participation with awareness of voter rights and responsibilities.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wanahimiza wananchi kuchanganya ushiriki katika mabaraza ya ushiriki wa umma na uelewa wa haki na wajibu wa mpiga kura.
Dholuo: Jotelo jiwo jodak mondo oket kanyakla ng'iyo e forum mag ng'iyo gi ji duto kod ng'eyo ratiro kod ting' mag jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu.

English: (EACC) urges Kenyans to be vigilant and avoid falling prey to fraudsters issuing fake integrity clearance letters at a fee
Kiswahili: (EACC) inawahimiza Wakenya kuwa macho na kuepuka kunaswa na matapeli wanaotoa barua bandia za uadilifu kwa ada
Dholuo: IECC jiwo jokenya mondo obed motang' kendo kik giyudre kod achudhe machiwo kad ma adiera kuom kawo omenda.

English: Residents are urged to report domestic violence through the county emergency hotline.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanahimizwa kuripoti unyanyasaji wa nyumbani kupitia laini ya dharura ya kaunti.
Dholuo: Okwayo jodak mondo ogol ripot mar tim gero mag ot kokalo kuom namba mar simu mar kaunti mar ng'ado bura mapiyo.

English: JLTM NGO documented over 500 protest-related arrests, urging release of minors and access to legal representation.
Kiswahili: Shirika lisilo la kiserikali la JLTM lilirekodi zaidi ya watu 500 waliokamatwa kuhusiana na maandamano, likihimiza kuachiliwa kwa watoto na kupata uwakilishi wa kisheria.
Dholuo: JLTM NGO ne ondiko weche mokalo 500 motudore gi makruok gi ji, ka gikwayo ni ogony nyithindo matindo kendo mondo giyud thuolo mar bedo e bwo chik.

English: Nairobi residents, beware of people who claim to provide business loans within an hour. The government does not have such a cash-in-hand program.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Nairobi, jihadharini na watu wanaodai kutoa mikopo ya biashara ndani ya saa moja. Serikali haina mpango kama huo wa pesa taslimu.
Dholuo: Jood Nairobi, tang'uru gi joma wacho ni gimiyou pesa ohala dichiel.

English: More teachers! Support hiring in underserved regions.
Kiswahili: Walimu zaidi! Saidia kuajiri katika maeneo ambayo hayana huduma za kutosha.
Dholuo: Jopuonj mang'eny! Konyuru joma dwaro tich e gwenge ma ji ok yudie tich.

English: Develop a clear business plan for your irrigation or dairy unit. Learn the essential components and how it helps in securing finance.
Kiswahili: Tengeneza mpango wa biashara ulio wazi kwa ajili ya kitengo chako cha umwagiliaji au cha maziwa. Jifunze vipengele muhimu na jinsi vinavyosaidia katika kupata fedha.
Dholuo: Tim chenro mar tiyo gi puothe mag lowo e yo mayot, kaka pi, kod pi. Puonjri gik madwarore mondo omi omi ng'ato oyud pesa.

English: Youth voter registration drive: Visit your school for free ID processing.
Kiswahili: Harakati ya usajili wa wapiga kura kwa vijana: Tembelea shule yako kwa usindikaji wa vitambulisho bila malipo.
Dholuo: Chenro mar riwo rowere e yiero: Dhi e sikul maru mondo iyud thuolo mar yudo kad mar yiero maonge chudo.

English: To reduce unfair resource allocation, the county is expanding access to passport application services this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza ugawaji usio wa haki wa rasilimali, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa huduma za maombi ya pasipoti mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogeng' ng'iewo mwandu ma ok owinjore, kauntino medo ng'iewo gik moko e higa ni.

English: President Ruto slams critics of SHA medical scheme, urges Kakamega residents to register
Kiswahili: Rais Ruto awakosoa wakosoaji wa mpango wa matibabu wa SHA, awahimiza wakazi wa Kakamega kujiandikisha
Dholuo: Ker Ruto okwedo rach mat chenro mar SHA, okwayo ji duto modak Kakamega mondo ondikre.

English: The rights of citizens to vote and to be elected at periodic, genuine democratic elections are internationally recognized human rights.
Kiswahili: Haki za raia kupiga kura na kuchaguliwa katika chaguzi za kidemokrasia za mara kwa mara na za kweli ni haki za binadamu zinazotambuliwa kimataifa.
Dholuo: Ratiro mar jopiny mar timo yiero kendo yiero mapile,yiero ma ratiro ong'e e piny mangima kaka yo mar chopo ratiro mar dhano.

English: Tallying Centres for The By-Elections Scheduled to be held on 14th May, 2026
Kiswahili: Vituo vya Kujumuika kwa ajili ya Uchaguzi Mdogo Uliopangwa kufanyika tarehe 14 Mei, 2026.
Dholuo: Kuonde mag kwano yiero mabiro timore tarik 14 dwe mar abich higa mar 2026

English: Educate students! Teach terror prevention in schools.
Kiswahili: Elimisha wanafunzi! Fundisha kuzuia ugaidi shuleni.
Dholuo: Puonj nyithindo! Puonj ji kaka ginyalo geng'o timbe mahundu e skul.

English: Observe curfews and security directives to support local safety measures.
Kiswahili: Fuata amri za kutotoka nje na maagizo ya usalama ili kuunga mkono hatua za usalama za eneo husika.
Dholuo: Luw chike mag dhoudi kod chike mag rito weche mag sirkal mondo omi omi omiyi teko mar rito weche mag sirkal.

English: Skits explore budget accountability
Kiswahili: Majaribio yanachunguza uwajibikaji wa bajeti
Dholuo: Sketch mar nono kaka pesa itiyogo e loso bajet

English: Subscribe to SMS alerts from the Meteorological Department to receive real-time flood warnings in your area.
Kiswahili: Jisajili kwa arifa za SMS kutoka Idara ya Hali ya Hewa ili upokee maonyo ya mafuriko ya wakati halisi katika eneo lako.
Dholuo: Som weche ma biro e gaset mar Meteorological Department mondo iyud siem e wi pi ma biro e alworau.

English: Caregivers should follow the national immunization schedule to protect children against deadly diseases such as measles, polio, and tuberculosis.
Kiswahili: Walezi wanapaswa kufuata ratiba ya kitaifa ya chanjo ili kuwalinda watoto dhidi ya magonjwa hatari kama vile surua, polio, na kifua kikuu.
Dholuo: Joma rito nyithindo onego oluw chenro moketi mar kano yedhe mag geng'o tuoche kaka, ayaki, polio, kod kahera.

English: Children in areas like Northern Kenya face abduction and recruitment into armed groups. Security agencies must prioritize their safety.
Kiswahili: Watoto katika maeneo kama Kaskazini mwa Kenya wanakabiliwa na utekaji nyara na kuajiriwa katika vikundi vyenye silaha. Mashirika ya usalama lazima yape kipaumbele usalama wao.
Dholuo: Nyithindo manie alwora kaka Northern Kenya yudo ka ikwalo kendo iketo e grube mag lweny.

English: Combine improving drainage with proper spacing to boost your tomatoes yield.
Kiswahili: Changanya kuboresha mifereji ya maji na nafasi sahihi ili kuongeza mavuno ya nyanya.
Dholuo: Kod loso yo maber mar pi kod keto thuolo mowinjore mondo omed nyaya mari.

English: If you fee unweel, have a cold, a cough or fever, please call 719 or text *719#
Kiswahili: Ikiwa unajisikia vibaya, una mafua, kikohozi au homa, tafadhali piga simu 719 au tuma ujumbe mfupi *719#
Dholuo: Kapo ni iwinjo ka ok iwinj maber, ka ituwo, ikayo, kata ibedo gi tuwo mar ndulme, tudri gi namba 719 kata oro sms *719#

English: Live CBC Grade 8 revision marathon starts 4PM daily – join free on KICD YouTube!
Kiswahili: Marathon ya marekebisho ya darasa la 8 ya CBC inaanza saa 4 usiku kila siku jiunge bure kwenye KICD YouTube!
Dholuo: Live CBC Grade 8 revision marathon chakore 4PM pile ka pile riwri nono e KICD YouTube!

English: Ministry releasing comprehensive strategy following success of KNAP 2018–2022, targeting multisectoral interventions to further reduce malnutrition rates.
Kiswahili: Wizara ikitoa mkakati kamili kufuatia mafanikio ya KNAP 2018–2022, ikilenga uingiliaji kati wa sekta mbalimbali ili kupunguza zaidi viwango vya utapiamlo.
Dholuo: Migawo mar weche mag chiemo ne ogolo chenro moro maduong' bang' KNAP 2018 ⁇ 2022, ma ne oriwo yore mopogore opogore mag konyo ji mondo kik gichak chamo chiemo moromo.

English: Anyone who witnesses human trafficking during disease outbreaks should alert authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeshuhudia usafirishaji haramu wa binadamu wakati wa milipuko ya magonjwa anapaswa kuarifu mamlaka mara moja.
Dholuo: Ng'at ang'ata ma neno ka ji uso dhano e kinde ma tuoche opong'o piny, onego onyis jotelo mapiyo.

English: Farmers growing tomatoes are advised to watch out for coffee berry disease this season.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaolima nyanya washauriwa kuchunga ugonjwa wa chungu wa kahawa msimu huu.
Dholuo: Jopur mapidho nyanya ipuonjogi mondo gibed gi ritruok kuom tuoche mag berry mag kahawa e kindeni.

English: Health workers recommend learning about mental health support alongside practicing safe disposal of medical waste at home.
Kiswahili: Wahudumu wa afya wanapendekeza kujifunza kuhusu usaidizi wa afya ya akili pamoja na kufanya utupaji salama wa taka za hospitalini nyumbani.
Dholuo: Jotich mag thieth nyiso ni onego opuonjre e wi konyo thieth mar paro kaachiel gi puonjruok mar wito yugi mag thieth e ot.

English: Keep your poultry healthy by monitoring for signs of brucellosis.
Kiswahili: Weka kuku wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za brusela.
Dholuo: Ket winy mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuo mar bruselosis.

English: Corrigenda - Certifying that the Revision of the Register of Voters has been completed for Purposes of the 9th August, 2022 General Election
Kiswahili: Corrigenda - Kuthibitisha kwamba Marekebisho ya Daftari la Wapiga Kura yamekamilika kwa Madhumuni ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa tarehe 9 Agosti, 2022.
