Kiswahili: AATF inatafuta mshauri wa kutengeneza na kupeleka kitovu cha kisasa cha usimamizi wa maarifa ambacho kitaboresha ushiriki wa taarifa za ndani na nje ...
Dholuo: AATF manyo jatelo manyalo chako kendo loso chenro mar tiego ji e weche mag tiegruok mabiro miyo weche mag tiegruok mag piny koda mag pinje obed maber.

English: Report invasive pests to your county agricultural officer without delay.
Kiswahili: Ripoti wadudu waharibifu kwa afisa kilimo wa kaunti yako bila kuchelewa.
Dholuo: Chiw ripot ne apisa mar pur mar kaunti mari maonge thuolo.

English: To reduce delayed government services, the county is expanding access to voter registration updates this year.
Kiswahili: Ili kupunguza huduma za serikali kuchelewa, kaunti inapanua upatikanaji wa masasisho ya usajili wa wapiga kura mwaka huu.
Dholuo: Mondo ogol dero mar tich ma sirkal timo, kaunti no medo yudo weche manyien mag ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu e higa ni.

English: Cholera outbreaks have been reported in the Republic of Kenya every year with large cyclical epidemics every five to seven years.
Kiswahili: Milipuko ya kipindupindu imeripotiwa katika Jamhuri ya Kenya kila mwaka huku kukiwa na milipuko mikubwa ya mzunguko kila baada ya miaka mitano hadi saba.
Dholuo: Kolera osebedo ka yudore e piny Kenya higa ka higa ka tuoche madongo ma ng'ato nyalo ng'ado bang' higni abich nyaka abiro.

English: Politics 'It's not your war': Ukraine's military ombud warns Africans against joining Russia's fight As South Africa probes how 17 of its citizens ended up in Ukraine's Donbas region, Kyiv's military ombud Olha Reshetylova urges Africans to resist Moscow's recruitment and avoid a war that offers them no protection.
Kiswahili: Siasa 'Sio vita vyenu': Mchunguzi wa kijeshi wa Ukraine awaonya Waafrika dhidi ya kujiunga na mapambano ya Urusi Huku Afrika Kusini ikichunguza jinsi raia wake 17 walivyoishia katika eneo la Donbas nchini Ukraine, mchunguzi wa kijeshi wa Kyiv Olha Reshetylova anawasihi Waafrika kupinga kuajiriwa na Moscow na kuepuka vita ambavyo haviwapi ulinzi wowote.
Dholuo: Timuru kwe 'Ok en Lweny maru': Ombud mar jolwennj Ukraine chiwo siem ne Jo-Afrika ni kik gidonj e lweny mar Russia ka South Africa neno kaka Jo-Ukraine apr kod abiriyo osetho e Donbas, Ombud Olga jiwo Jo-Afrika mondo okwed tich ma Moscow timo kendo gitang' gi lweny ma miyo gibedo maonge arita.

English: Protect your sweet potatoes from root rot by using certified seeds.
Kiswahili: Linda viazi vitamu yako dhidi ya kuoza kwa mizizi kwa kutumia mbegu zilizothibitishwa.
Dholuo: Riek ng'injo mari mondo kik otur kuom tiyo kod kodhi ma nigi oboke mar ng'injo.

English: Teachers recommend combining asking questions in class with regular attendance to address student unrest.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kuuliza maswali darasani na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia machafuko ya wanafunzi.
Dholuo: Jopuonj ogolo paro ni mondo oriw penjo e klas kod bedo e klas kinde ka kinde mondo ilos ywak mar nyithind skul.

English: Appointment of Nyeri County Returning Officer for Purposes of Nominating Candidates for the General Election Scheduled to be held on 9th August, 2022
Kiswahili: Uteuzi wa Msimamizi wa Uchaguzi wa Kaunti ya Nyeri kwa Madhumuni ya Kuwateua Wagombeaji wa Uchaguzi Mkuu ulioratibiwa kufanyika tarehe 9 Agosti, 2022.
Dholuo: Ochung' ne Opiis mar Yiero mar Kaunti mar Nyeri mondo Oket Jotelo mabiro bedo e yiero maduong' ma ibiro tim tarik 9 dwe mar aboro higa mar 2022

English: Be cautious of 'too good to be true' offers for rentals or purchases.
Kiswahili: Kuwa mwangalifu na ofa za 'nzuri sana kuwa kweli' za kukodisha au ununuzi.
Dholuo: Tang' gi gik ma nyalo miyo ng'ato ochul ot kata odag e ot ma jaode dwaro ni odagie.

English: Understanding your constitutional rights makes it easier to report delayed government services when you see it.
Kiswahili: Kuelewa haki zako za kikatiba hurahisisha kuripoti huduma za serikali kuchelewa unapoiona.
Dholuo: Ka ing'eyo ratiro ma iketo e chik piny, mano miyo bedo mayot mondo ior ripot mar tich ma sirkal osetimo bang' kinde ka inene.

English: Prepare an emergency kit in case of disease outbreaks in your area.
Kiswahili: Andaa vifaa vya dharura endapo kutakuwa na milipuko ya magonjwa eneo lako.
Dholuo: Inyalo loso gik ma inyalo tiyogo mapiyo ka tuoche ochako pong'o piny e alworau.

English: Teachers recommend combining daily reading with regular attendance to address lack of learning materials.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kusoma kila siku na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia ukosefu wa vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Dholuo: Jopuonj golo paro ni mondo oriw somo ma pile ka pile kod bedo e chokruoge pile mondo ilos bedo maonge gi gige somo.

English: Anyone who witnesses a road accident during fire disasters should alert authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeshuhudia ajali ya barabarani wakati wa majanga ya moto anapaswa kuarifu mamlaka mara moja.
Dholuo: Ng'at ang'ata ma neno masira mar yo e kinde ma masira mar mach timore, onego onyis jotelo mapiyo.

English: Enroll your child in Senior School before the term begins.
Kiswahili: Andikisha mtoto wako katika shule ya upili ya juu kabla ya muhula kuanza.
Dholuo: Inyalo ndiko nying nyathini e Skul Maduong' kapok term ochako.

English: AP featured families of protest victims expressing grief, frustration with impunity, and demands for justice and oversight reforms.
Kiswahili: AP iliangazia familia za waathiriwa wa maandamano zikielezea huzuni, kukatishwa tamaa na kutokujali, na madai ya haki na mageuzi ya usimamizi.
Dholuo: AP ne onyiso kaka jood joma ne oketho e lwenyno ne nyiso kuyo, chunygi ne onyosore nikech ne ok giyud kum, kendo ne gidwaro ni otim lokruok e yo makare.

English: Teachers recommend combining regular homework review with regular attendance to address student unrest.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanapendekeza kuchanganya kupitia kazi za nyumbani mara kwa mara na mahudhurio ya mara kwa mara kushughulikia machafuko ya wanafunzi.
Dholuo: Jopuonj golo paro ni mondo oriw somo mar tije mag ot pile ka pile kod chopo e chokruoge pile ka pile mar geng'o ywak mar nyithind sikul.

English: A section of the Isiolo "Meru community has raised concerns over what they describe as rampant bad governance within the county administration. The leaders accused local officials of mismanagement and failing to fulfill key development pledges.
Kiswahili: Sehemu ya jamii ya Isiolo "Meru" imeibua wasiwasi kuhusu kile wanachokielezea kama utawala mbaya uliokithiri ndani ya utawala wa kaunti. Viongozi hao waliwashutumu maafisa wa eneo hilo kwa usimamizi mbaya na kushindwa kutimiza ahadi muhimu za maendeleo.
Dholuo: Moko kuom joma odak e alwora mar Isiolo osechako bedo gi luoro e wi gima giwacho ni en loch marach ahinya e kauntino. Jotelo go seyo jotelo ma aluorano kuom telo marach kod koso chopo singo mag dongruok.

English: Do not give your M-PESA PIN to anyone! This is a very common scam.
Kiswahili: Usimpe mtu yeyote PIN yako ya M-PESA! Huu ni ulaghai wa kawaida sana.
Dholuo: Kik imi ng'ato ang'ata PIN mar M-PESA!

English: Advocate for stronger anti-corruption measures to safeguard human rights.
Kiswahili: Tetea hatua kali zaidi za kupambana na rushwa ili kulinda haki za binadamu.
Dholuo: Dhi nyime jiwo ni mondo omi ji oyud thuolo mar timo dongruok e weche mag siasa.

English: Vaccinate your pigs against mastitis before the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Chanja nguruwe yako dhidi ya maambukizi ya kiwele kabla ya msimu wa mvua.
Dholuo: Chiw ng'ombe mari chanjo mar geng'o tuo mar master kapok kinde koth ochopo.

English: Train on sustainability 2024.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo kuhusu uendelevu 2024.
Dholuo: Tieguru ji mondo odag e ngima maber nyaka 2024.

English: Visit a health facility if you experience symptoms of persistent cough.
Kiswahili: Tembelea kituo cha afya iwapo utaona dalili za kikohozi cha kudumu.
Dholuo: Dhi e kar thieth ka iyudo ranyisi mag ahonda ma ok rum.

English: An examination of patented technologies related to agricultural biotechnology illustrated the large in- crease in both public and private sector patents since.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi wa teknolojia zilizo na hati miliki zinazohusiana na bioteknolojia ya kilimo ulionyesha ongezeko kubwa la hati miliki za sekta ya umma na binafsi tangu wakati huo.
Dholuo: Nonro mosetim kuom weche mag teknoloji motudore gi timo pur mar yien, nyiso ni kwan mar mwandu mag dhano kod mag ji osemedore ahinya chakre kindeno.

English: KUCCPS opens direct university entry for TVET graduates – apply before Dec 31!
Kiswahili: KUCCPS yafungua kiingilio cha moja kwa moja cha chuo kikuu kwa wahitimu wa TVET – kutuma maombi kabla ya Desemba 31!
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyawo thuolo mar donjo e yunivasiti achiel kachiel ne jogo ma osetieko tiegruok e yore mag TVET.

English: Protect your rice from termites by rotating crops.
Kiswahili: Linda mchele yako dhidi ya mchwa kwa kubadilisha mazao.
Dholuo: Rit mcheche mari mondo kik oyud winyo kuom loko cham ma ipidho.

English: Director-General Urges New Ambassadors to Uphold Integrity and Professionalism
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi Mkuu Awahimiza Mabalozi Wapya Kudumisha Uadilifu na Utaalamu
Dholuo: Jatelo Maduong ' jiwo jombetre manyien mag Kenya mondo omed bedo joma timbegi beyo kendo molony.

English: 26–27–2–2017 Special IEBC Suspension of Voter Registration, Centers for Prisons Diaspora, ROs, AROs for Prisons and Diaspora
Kiswahili: 26–27–2–2017 Usitishaji Maalum wa IEBC wa Usajili wa Wapiga Kura, Vituo vya Magereza Diaspora, ROs, AROs kwa Magereza na Diaspora
Dholuo: 26-27-2-2017 IEBC makende ogeng'o ndiko nying' jogo ma dhi goyo ombulu, Senta mag jela mag jogo ma ni e pinje ma oko, ROs, AROs mag jela kod jogo ma ni e pinje ma oko

English: Avoid using public Wi-Fi for banking. Hackers can steal your data.
Kiswahili: Epuka kutumia Wi-Fi ya umma kwa ajili ya benki. Wadukuzi wanaweza kuiba data yako.
Dholuo: Kik iti gi Intanet e weche mag bengi nikech jonjore mag Intanet nyalo kwalo weche ma in-go.

English: Know your rights and demand integrity from public officials to reduce corruption risks.
Kiswahili: Jua haki zako na udai uadilifu kutoka kwa maafisa wa umma ili kupunguza hatari za ufisadi.
Dholuo: Ng'e ratiro ma in-go kendo iket chik mondo jotich sirkal obed joma ler mondo okonygi giduok chien rach ma giyudo nikech mibadhi.

English: Participate in county budget consultations to have your voice heard in local decisions.
Kiswahili: Shiriki katika mashauriano ya bajeti ya kaunti ili sauti yako isikike katika maamuzi ya eneo lako.
Dholuo: Ibed gi paro e wi bajet mar kaunti mondo dwondi owinji e yiero mag alwora.

English: Bleeding, severe headaches, blurred vision, or swelling are danger signs —seek care immediately.
Kiswahili: Kutokwa na damu, maumivu makali ya kichwa, kuona vibaya, au uvimbe ni dalili za hatari - tafuta huduma mara moja.
Dholuo: Rembruok, wich malit, neno ma ok nen maber, kata chwoyo gin ranyisi mag masira.

English: The Commission calls upon business owners to stay alert to during the election period.
Kiswahili: Tume inatoa wito kwa wamiliki wa biashara kuwa macho wakati wa uchaguzi.
Dholuo: Kamison dwaro ni jolok ohala obed motang' sama itimo yiero.

English: A report documented systemic excessive force during protests and called for prosecutions, crowd control reforms, and stronger conduct enforcement mechanisms.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ilirekodi matumizi mabaya ya nguvu wakati wa maandamano na kutoa wito wa mashtaka, mageuzi ya udhibiti wa umati, na mifumo imara ya utekelezaji wa mwenendo.
Dholuo: Ripot moro ne nyiso kaka ne itiyo gi teko mokalo tong' e kinde mar protest kendo ne okwayo mondo oter kes, otim lokruok e wi kaka ne itiyo gi teko mar chiko ji, kendo mondo omi chike mag tayo timbe ji obed motegno.

English: Take your child for regular weight and height checks to detect growth issues early.
Kiswahili: Mpeleke mtoto wako kwa ajili ya uchunguzi wa uzito na urefu mara kwa mara ili kugundua matatizo ya ukuaji mapema.
Dholuo: Kaw nyathini mondo inon pek kod borne kinde ka kinde, mondo ifweny chon kapo ni nitie gimoro ma ok dhi maber e dongo.

English: Submit a Letter of Intent If a country passes the Core Eligibility Criteria and Values Check and the government identified a lead ministry or agency, it should signal its intent to participate in OGP by sending a Letter of Intent, which formally expresses the government's intention to join OGP.
Kiswahili: Wasilisha Barua ya Nia Ikiwa nchi itapita Vigezo vya Msingi vya Ustahiki na Ukaguzi wa Maadili na serikali ikatambua wizara au shirika linaloongoza, inapaswa kuashiria nia yake ya kushiriki katika OGP kwa kutuma Barua ya Nia, ambayo inaelezea rasmi nia ya serikali ya kujiunga na OGP.
Dholuo: Chiw barua mar chiwruok kapo ni piny moro oseng'ado chike moting'o chike kod weche mochuno, kendo sirkal osefwenyo ni en gi migawo kata riwruok ma tayo tij lendo, sirkal onego onyis ni odwaro riwo lwedo OGP kuom oro barua mar chiwruok ma nyiso ni sirkal dwaro riwo lwedo OGP.

English: Install security cameras at entry points and make them visible.
Kiswahili: Sakinisha kamera za usalama kwenye sehemu za kuingilia na uzifanye zionekane.
Dholuo: Ket kamera mag sirkal e kuonde ma idonjoe kendo iketgi e yo ma nenore.

English: Residential facilities for persons with disabilities require strong safeguards and accessible education on rights and reporting.
Kiswahili: Vifaa vya makazi kwa watu wenye ulemavu vinahitaji ulinzi mkali na elimu inayopatikana kwa urahisi kuhusu haki na utoaji wa taarifa.
Dholuo: Ute oma odak gi ng'ol onego obed gi rit motegno kendo gibed gi thuolo mar yudo puonj e wi wach ratiro mag gi kod chiwo ripot.

English: Government distributes mosquito nets in malaria fight. Kilifi County is one of the beneficiaries. Nets program was flagged over procurement irregularities. MOH wants to distribute 15M nets in 22 counties
Kiswahili: Serikali yasambaza vyandarua katika mapambano dhidi ya malaria. Kaunti ya Kilifi ni mojawapo ya wanufaika. Programu ya vyandarua iliangaziwa kwa ukiukwaji wa sheria za ununuzi. Wizara ya Afya inataka kusambaza vyandarua milioni 15 katika kaunti 22
Dholuo: Sirkal pogo net mag kwiri e kedo gi malaria. Kaunti mar Kilifi en achiel kuom joma yudo kony. Chenro mar Nets ne oket e bwo chik nikech gik ma ok kare ma ne timore e chenro mag ng'iewo. MOH dwaro pogo net 15M e counties 22

English: In a speech read on his behalf by the KPC General Manager Finance, Pius Mwendwa during the facility's soft launch, Sang said the successful launch of the facility heralds a new paradigm in the reticulation of the product with immense benefits to the public.
Kiswahili: Katika hotuba iliyosomwa kwa niaba yake na Meneja Mkuu wa Fedha wa KPC, Pius Mwendwa wakati wa uzinduzi wa kituo hicho, Sang alisema uzinduzi uliofanikiwa wa kituo hicho unaashiria dhana mpya katika ujumuishaji wa bidhaa hiyo yenye faida kubwa kwa umma.
Dholuo: E twak ma nogolo e loye kod meneja mar omenda ma mwanywanda KPC Pius Mwende e odiechieng ' ma ne ochakgo tijno, Sang nowacho ni chako tijno e yo maber ne dhi kelo ber mang'eny ne jopiny.

English: Improper handling of corpses risks disease outbreaks. Follow Textlines from health authorities during mass fatalities.
Kiswahili: Utunzaji usiofaa wa maiti unahatarisha mlipuko wa magonjwa. Fuata Ujumbe wa maandishi kutoka kwa mamlaka za afya wakati wa vifo vya watu wengi.
Dholuo: Ka ng'ato ok tim maber gi ringre jomotho, mano nyalo miyo tuwoche omedre. Lu chike mogol kod ute thieth mondo uchor ringre jomotho

English: Government urges pensioners to register to avoid payroll suspension To all government pensioners, you are urged to register on the e-Citizen platform by the extended deadline of 10th May, the government spokesperson said.
Kiswahili: Serikali inawasihi wastaafu kujiandikisha ili kuepuka kusimamishwa kwa mishahara. Kwa wastaafu wote wa serikali, mnahimizwa kujiandikisha kwenye jukwaa la kielektroniki la Citizen ifikapo tarehe ya mwisho iliyoongezwa ya Mei 10, msemaji wa serikali alisema.
Dholuo: Sirkal jiwo joma yudo pes rutaya mondo ondikre mondo gikwed chudo duto ma sirkal chiwo, kendo gidwaro ni gidonj e e-Citizen e giko dwe mar abich tarik apar , jaloso e loo sirkal nowacho.

English: Machakos County community policing attributed to crime reduction in Mwala sub‑county
Kiswahili: Polisi jamii wa Kaunti ya Machakos wahusishwa na kupungua kwa uhalifu katika kaunti ndogo ya Mwala
Dholuo: Polise mar alwora mar County ma Machakos ne okonyo e tieko mahundu e sub county mar Mwala

English: Research has shown that strengthening women's access to agri-food markets generates increased and stable incomes, laying a foundation for their ...
Kiswahili: Utafiti umeonyesha kwamba kuimarisha upatikanaji wa wanawake katika masoko ya chakula cha kilimo huzalisha mapato yaliyoongezeka na imara, na kuweka msingi wa ...
Dholuo: Nonro mosetim nyiso ni miyo mon thuolo mar bedo e chiro mar chiemo e piny mangima kelo pesa momedore kendo mosiko, kendo mano miyo...

English: New green-energy TVET curriculum launched – free download on KICD site now!
Kiswahili: Mtaala mpya wa TVET wa nishati ya kijani ulizinduliwa "upakuaji wa bure kwenye tovuti ya KICD sasa!"
Dholuo: Chenro manyien mar tiegruok e yore mag TVET ma tiyo gi teko mar lowo ne ochak download e websait mar KICD sani!

English: Grade 6 must register for KPSEA by February 28.
Kiswahili: Darasa la 6 lazima lijiandikishe kwa KPSEA ifikapo Februari 28.
Dholuo: Jopuonjre mag klas mar 6 nyaka ndikre e KPSEA kapok ochopo tarik 28 Februar.

English: Women play a key role in fish value chain. Learn about specific initiatives and markets that support women's participation and empowerment.
Kiswahili: Wanawake wana jukumu muhimu katika mnyororo wa thamani wa samaki. Jifunze kuhusu mipango na masoko maalum yanayounga mkono ushiriki na uwezeshaji wa wanawake.
Dholuo: Mon ni gi tich maduong' moloyo e chiro mar nengo rech. Puonjri kuom chenro mar chiro ma konyo riwruok kod nyalo mar mine.

English: Key points to stop Mpox spread: Avoid close contact with individuals showing symptoms. Do not share personal items like towels, utensils, or clothing. Maintain good hygiene by washing hands frequently.
Kiswahili: Mambo muhimu ya kuzuia kuenea kwa Mpox: Epuka kugusana kwa karibu na watu wanaoonyesha dalili. Usishiriki vitu vya kibinafsi kama vile taulo, vyombo, au nguo. Dumisha usafi mzuri kwa kunawa mikono mara kwa mara.
Dholuo: Weche madongo mag geng'o landruok mar Mpox: Kik ibed machiegni gi joma nigi ranyisi mag tuwono. Kik inyis ng'at machielo gik ma in-go, kaka togo, sende, kata lewni. Bed ng'ama ler kuom luoko lweteni kinde ka kinde.

English: Tana River residents urged to reject attempts by politicians to divide them along ethnic lines for personal gain.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Tana River wahimizwa kukataa majaribio ya wanasiasa ya kuwagawanya kwa misingi ya kikabila kwa ajili ya faida zao binafsi.
Dholuo: Jodak e Aora Tana nojiw mondo okwed pogruok ma josiasa ne timo e kindgi mondo giyud ber giwegi.

English: The National Disaster Operations Centre has issued an update on severe weather warnings.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kitaifa cha Uendeshaji wa Maafa kimetoa taarifa kuhusu tahadhari za hali mbaya ya hewa.
Dholuo: Ofis mar piny mangima ma rito masira osegolo wach manyien kuom siem mag yamo mager.

English: Parents should register the birth of their child at the nearest civil registration office. A birth certificate secures a child's legal identity and access to services.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanapaswa kusajili kuzaliwa kwa mtoto wao katika ofisi ya usajili wa kiraia iliyo karibu. Cheti cha kuzaliwa kinahakikisha utambulisho wa kisheria wa mtoto na upatikanaji wa huduma.
Dholuo: Jonyuol onego ondik nying nyathigi e rejistari mar anyuola machiegni kodgi. Satifiket mar nyuol miyo nyathi bedo ng'at ma sirkal oyiego, kendo miyo oyudo kony.

English: "DCI is investigating a fake 'youth startup grant' program circulating on TikTok and Instagram. There is no such initiative funded by the Government of Kenya."
Kiswahili: "DCI inachunguza mpango bandia wa 'ruzuku ya vijana wanaoanza' unaosambazwa kwenye TikTok na Instagram. Hakuna mpango kama huo unaofadhiliwa na Serikali ya Kenya."
Dholuo: "DCI nono chenro mar miriambo ma yudore e TikTok kod Instagram. onge chenro ma kamano ma sirkal mar Kenya nigo mar chiwo pesa".

English: Stay alert for updates on landslide risk from official government channels.
Kiswahili: Kaa macho kwa taarifa kuhusu hatari ya maporomoko ya ardhi kutoka njia rasmi za serikali.
Dholuo: Bed gi ritruok mondo iyud weche manyien ewi luoro mar osruok mar lowo kowuok e chanel ma sirkal mapile.

English: (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, visited the National Syndemic Diseases Control Council (NSDCC) for a briefing on Kenya's coordinated response to HIV and other syndemic diseases.
Kiswahili: (Dkt.) James Nyikal, Mbunge, alitembelea Baraza la Kitaifa la Kudhibiti Magonjwa ya Sindemic (NSDCC) kwa muhtasari wa mwitikio ulioratibiwa wa Kenya kwa VVU na magonjwa mengine ya sindemic.
Dholuo: (Dr.) James Nyikal, MP, nodhi e bura mar piny mangima mar rito tuoche ma nyalo landore (NSDCC) mondo oyud puonj kuom kaka piny Kenya ochung' motegno e wi tuoche mag HIV kod tuoche mamoko ma nyalo landore.

English: Anyone who witnesses theft during mass gatherings should alert authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Yeyote anayeshuhudia wizi wakati wa mikusanyiko mikubwa anapaswa kuarifu mamlaka mara moja.
Dholuo: Ng'at ang'ata ma neno kuo e kinde ma ji mang'eny romoe onego onyis jotelo mapiyo.

English: Stay in school! Avoid protest zones for safety.
Kiswahili: Endelea shuleni! Epuka maeneo ya maandamano kwa ajili ya usalama.
Dholuo: Bed e skul! Kik udhi kuonde ma ji ng'urie nikech mano nyalo kelonu hinyruok.

English: Report child labor, forced marriage, and abuse to relevant authorities or hotlines.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ajira ya watoto, ndoa ya kulazimishwa, na unyanyasaji kwa mamlaka husika au simu za dharura.
Dholuo: Nyis jotelo kata joma tiyo gi simo ni itiyo gi nyithindo e tich, ikendgi gi thuon, kendo iti gi joma itiyogo e timo timbe mag achaya.

English: Keep your donkeys healthy by monitoring for signs of rabies.
Kiswahili: Weka punda wako na afya kwa kuchunguza dalili za kichaa cha mbwa.
Dholuo: Ket punda mari obed gi ngima maber kuom luwo ranyisi mag tuo mar rabies.

English: Attend your nearest clinic for family planning services this month.
Kiswahili: Hudhuria kliniki ya karibu kwa huduma za uzazi wa mpango mwezi huu.
Dholuo: Dhi e klinik man machiegni kodi mondo iyud kony mar keto chenro mar anyuola e dwe mar apar.
